title: Intel crashes 29% and Big Tech's cash burn drags the Nasdaq down 2% for the week
short: Intel crashes 29%, Big Tech's cash burn sinks the Nasdaq
dek: Weak results from Alphabet, Amazon and Intel turned AI spending worries into a sell-off. The S&P 500 fell for a third week, oil rose and gold slid below $3,900.
card: S&P 500 −0.6%, Nasdaq −2%, Dow −0.9% for the week. Brent near $118, gold at a one-year low. What it means for India on Monday.
